====There is a number of utility calsses in unicase to do diffrent tasks. Here you will find a list of them along with a brief description.====

*SetupHelper*
org.unicase.workspace.test.SetupHelper
Helper class for setup/cleanup test fixtures.

*AccessControlHelper*
org.unicase.workspace.accesscontrol.AccessControlHelper
Helper class for access control checks.

*ActionHelper*
org.unicase.ui.common.util.ActionHelper
This class contains some utility method for commands and handlers.

*ChangePackageVisualizationHelper*
org.unicase.workspace.ui.views.changes.ChangePackageVisualizationHelper
A helper class for the visualization of change packages.

*EstimateHelper*
org.unicase.model.task.util.EstimateHelper
EstimateHelper for computing numbers/estimates of a ModelElements LeafOpeners. LeafOpeners are a subset of all tasks in the OpeningLinkTaxonomy that a ModelElements needs to be closed in order to be closed itself. See also: TaxonomyAccess.getInstance().getOpeningLinkTaxonomy().getLeafOpeners(ModelElement)

*InegrationTestHelper*
org.unicase.workspace.test.integration.forward.IntegrationTestHelper
Helper class for testing.

*ModelValidationHelper*
org.unicase.model.util.ModelValidationHelper
Helps with the validation of EMF models.

*NotificationHelper*
org.unicase.workspace.notification.provider.NotificationHelper
This class offer helper methods for notifications.

*OpeningLinkHelper*
org.unicase.model.task.util.OpeningLinkHelper
this class provides methods related to opening links and depends on the current OpeningLinkTaxonomy.

*OrgUnitHelper*
org.unicase.workspace.util.OrgUnitHelper
Helper for OrgUnit operations.

*ResourceHelper*
org.unicase.emfstore.core.helper.ResourceHelper
Helper for creating resources etc.

*TaskValidationHelper*
org.unicase.model.task.validation.TaskValidationHelper
Helper for task validation.

*URLHelper*
org.unicase.ui.common.util.URLHelper
This class offer helper methods for the unicase URLs.

*ValidationConstraintHelper*
org.unicase.model.util.ValidationConstraintHelper
Helps with validation of modelelements.

*CommandUtility*
org.unicase.ui.common.diagram.util.CommandUtility
Utility class for common operations on GEF commands.

*DashboardImageUtil*
org.unicase.workspace.ui.dashboard.DashboardImageUtil
A utility class to handle images in the dashboard.

*EditPartUtility*
org.unicase.ui.common.diagram.util.EditPartUtility

*EsModelUtil*
org.unicase.emfstore.esmodel.util.EsModelUtil
Helper class for emf store model related tasks.

*EventUtil*
org.unicase.workspace.util.EventUtil
Helper class to log events.

*FilePartionerUtil*
org.unicase.emfstore.filetransfer.FilePartitionerUtil
File transfer utility class.

*FileTransferUtil*
org.unicase.workspace.util.FileTransferUtil
Utility methods for the file transfer interface. Important notice regarding the terminology used: construct means that the file or folder location is put together from different strings, i.e. the file or folder does not have to exists. find means that the method tries to localize the file. Failing in retrieving the file will throw an exception.

*FileUtil*
org.unicase.model.util.FileUtil
Helper class for file system operations.

*ModelUtil*
org.unicase.model.util.ModelUtil
Utility class for ModelElements.

*SerializationUtil*
org.unicase.emfstore.connection.rmi.SerializationUtil
Helper class for serializing and deserializing EObjects for RMI transport.

*ServerTestUtil*
org.unicase.test.servertests.ServerTestUtil

*UnicaseUiUtil*
org.unicase.ui.common.util.UnicaseUiUtil
Utility class for user interface tasks, such as showing selection dialog or report error dialog.

*WorkspaceUtil*
org.unicase.workspace.util.WorkspaceUtil
Workspace utility class.
